Outer-grid posterior covariance of a joint fit's latent coordinates

Source: R/nested_laplace_joint_helpers.R
tulpa_joint_inner_vcov_mixture.Rd

The law-of-total-covariance mixture over the outer grid, $$V = \sum_k w_k [C_k + (m_k - \bar m)(m_k - \bar m)^T],$$ with C_k the same per-cell constrained block tulpa_joint_inner_vcov_blocks() returns, accumulated inside the engine without holding one block per cell. Memory is one length(idx) square result whatever the grid size, so this is the door for an idx that carries a field.

Usage

tulpa_joint_inner_vcov_mixture(
  Q_p_per_grid,
  Q_i_per_grid,
  Q_x_per_grid,
  n_x,
  idx,
  n_dense,
  A_cols_list,
  weights,
  modes = NULL,
  field_marginal = TRUE,
  n_threads = 1L
)

Arguments

Q_p_per_grid, Q_i_per_grid, Q_x_per_grid

Per-outer-grid-cell CSC storage of the latent precision Q (fit$Q_csc_p_per_grid / _i_per_grid / _x_per_grid), one list element per cell.

n_x

Integer, the latent dimension Q is built over (fit$Q_csc_n).

idx

Integer vector (1-based) of latent coordinates to extract the sub-block for.

n_dense

Integer, the number of leading idx entries that are dense fixed effects rather than field coordinates (see Details).

A_cols_list

A list of integer vectors, one per sum-to-zero constraint group, each the (1-based) latent coordinates that group averages to zero.

weights

Numeric, one non-negative weight per outer-grid cell (normalized here). A cell of zero weight is never extracted.

modes

Optional n_grid x length(idx) matrix of the cell modes on idx. NULL returns the within-cell term alone.

field_marginal

Logical; if TRUE (default) and n_dense < length(idx), only the field coordinates' marginal variances are computed (a single Takahashi pass) rather than their full dense sub-block.

n_threads

Integer, grid cells processed concurrently.

Value

A list: vcov, the mixture covariance; mean, the weighted mean of modes (NULL without them); dense_blocks, one n_dense x n_dense block per cell (NULL where the cell was not extracted); failed, the cells of positive weight whose block is missing (no stored precision, or its Cholesky failed). Such a cell keeps its weight and contributes its between-cell term only. With field_marginal = TRUE the field x field part of the within term is its diagonal.

Examples

# Two outer-grid cells of a latent precision over two fixed effects and a
# ten-node random-walk field (sum-to-zero), each stored as the lower-triangle
# CSC a joint fit keeps per cell, with the cells' modes and weights.
make_Q <- function(tau) {
  Q <- matrix(0, 12, 12)
  Q[1:2, 1:2] <- diag(2, 2) + 0.1
  Q[3:12, 3:12] <- tau * crossprod(diff(diag(10))) + diag(0.3, 10)
  Q[1, 3:12] <- Q[3:12, 1] <- 0.1
  L <- Matrix::tril(methods::as(methods::as(Q, "generalMatrix"),
                                "CsparseMatrix"))
  list(p = L@p, i = L@i, x = L@x)
}
cells <- list(make_Q(1), make_Q(4))
set.seed(1)
modes <- matrix(rnorm(2 * 12, sd = 0.2), 2, 12)
mix <- tulpa_joint_inner_vcov_mixture(
  lapply(cells, `[[`, "p"), lapply(cells, `[[`, "i"), lapply(cells, `[[`, "x"),
  n_x = 12L, idx = 1:12, n_dense = 2L, A_cols_list = list(3:12),
  weights = c(0.7, 0.3), modes = modes)
mix$mean[1:2]
#> [1] -0.07668493 -0.02127116
mix$vcov[1:2, 1:2]
#>              [,1]         [,2]
#> [1,]  0.482785289 -0.006185382
#> [2,] -0.006185382  0.526911020
